title: Breaking the Death Spiral: Balancing Authenticity and Feasibility in Parameterized Narrative AI
snippet: A paper co-authored by Colin Milburn, titled 'Breaking the Death Spiral: Balancing Authenticity and Feasibility in Parameterized Narrative AI', was presented at the IEEE Conference on Games (CoG) 2026 in Madrid, Spain.
match_reason: websearch (publication) — Colin Milburn is a co-author of this paper, representing his research at the UC Davis Center for Artificial Intelligence and Experimental Futures.
